# Personal Best Practices — 11-integration-manager

- No Development-selected seam? Don't stage another PACK.
- Pin donor source, license, insertion seam and negative test; no speculative adoption.
- PACK staged ≠ Dev integrated ≠ live working.
- Verify Markdown links from the containing file, not from assumed repo root.
- Diagnose actual evidence before adapting source to guessed symptoms.
